sources.citation: Honda EU2200i OM 00X31Z446010 (http://cdn.powerequipment.honda.com/pe/pdf/manuals/00X31Z446010.pdf); EU3000i Handi OM 00X31Z286131 (http://cdn.powerequipment.honda.com/pe/pdf/manuals/00X31Z286131.pdf); Honda accessories catalogue p5-15 (checked: 2026-09-01)

transport: none — no electric starter, no remote input.
gotchas: Honda: remote kits are "for use with generators equipped with electric start and automatic choke only" — neither model listed (cat. p5-15). GenStart's manuals page lists no kit for either.
Hutch Mountain sells no start kit of any kind (https://www.hutchmountain.com/collections/all). Frog Products electric-start kits exist but their site returned a placeholder/404 — `unverified`.
